scope: Blade git lanes preserved by the claude-cloud finalization: every Blade branch, detached worktree HEAD and uncommitted worktree snapshot whose exact commit was not on main. Unverified work, not runtime code.
restore: git bundle verify .devloop/handoff/mios-blade-lane-archive.bundle && git fetch .devloop/handoff/mios-blade-lane-archive.bundle 'refs/archive/blade/*:refs/archive/blade/*'  (prerequisite: main at or after base_main)
negative_controls_note: Refs with negative_control_subjects > 0 contain commits named as negative controls, mutants or plants. Never merge their code into main as-is.
snapshot_note: uncommitted-snapshot refs were captured with a temporary index (explicit paths: tracked modified/deleted + untracked non-ignored); the owner's worktree, index and refs were not changed.
secret_scan: Every blob introduced by these refs was pattern-scanned before publication; the only hits were test fixtures already present on public main.
